title: X0 Bot: Peek-a-bot, soft matte
subtitle: One big matte head peeking up into the tile from the bottom edge. Our identity is the dark glass visor band with two warm eyes, plus a short antenna with a warm tip (no ball). Ranked, strongest first. The dashed card is the Grok Bot icon, for comparison only.

cream-black.title: Cream on black
cream-black.line: The purest version: a cream head rising into black, its visor lit by two warm eyes. It reads from across a room.

curious.title: Curious
curious.line: The same head entering on a tilt from the bottom left, eyes glancing up. It has the most life and diagonal energy.

coral-black.title: Coral on black
coral-black.line: One bold colour. It holds its own among colourful apps, and coral rather than orange keeps it away from a pumpkin.

wink.title: Wink
wink.line: Number 1 with a wink: one eye closed in a smile. More personality, a little less calm.

cream-clay.title: Cream on clay
cream-clay.line: The warmest and most on-brand ground. Clay is a quieter ground than black, so the head pops less.

ink-cream.title: Ink on cream
ink-cream.line: A charcoal matte head with a gloss-black visor on cream. Premium up close; the visor and head merge when small.

reference.title: Grok Bot (reference)
reference.line: Not ours: the icon the owner pointed to, shown for level and distinctness.
